description: Source code for a report designer module in an OpenERP/Odoo project, defining a class for handling report XML and conversion between SXW and RML formats.

classes.name: report_xml
classes.description: A class extending 'ir.actions.report.xml' to add methods for converting SXW files to RML and uploading reports.

methods.name: sxwtorml
methods.description: Converts an SXW file to RML format using an XSL transformation.

methods.name: upload_report
methods.description: Uploads and processes a report SXW file, converting it to RML and saving it in the database.

methods.name: report_get
methods.description: Retrieves report content, encoding it in base64 for transfer.
